Play Sequence: 1. Each player creates a deck. 2. Divide your cards into Groups and Plots. Shuffle your Plot deck. 3. Put out your Illuminati card. 4. Draw 3 Plot cards for your hand. 5. Choose a Group as a puppet and reveal it. Anyone who plays a duplicate must try again. Shuffle your Groups deck. 6. Draw 6 Group cards for your hand. 7. Roll to see who takes the first turn. Each Turn . . . 1. Draw a Plot card, if you wish. 2. Draw a Group card, if you wish. 3. Make one automatic takeover. 4. Place your Action tokens. 5. Attempt attacks or other actions. 6. Take any remaining free moves. 7. Laugh evilly and rap the table to alert the next player that youre through. Cheat Sheet Alignments Conservative opposes Liberal. Straight opposes Weird. Corporate opposes Government. Peaceful opposes Violent. Fanatic opposes Fanatic. Criminal has no opposite.

Basic Goals At the beginning of the game, decide how many groups will be required to win. The more groups, the longer the game: Quick game 10 groups Average game 11 groups Long, vicious game 12 groups Fnord This line does not exist.
This box holds one deck of 55 Illuminati: New World Order trading cards, more than enough to begin your struggle for world domination. These cards are part of the Limited Edition of Illuminati: New World Order. There are 409 cards in the first release. Unlimited Edition: [Link]

18-Minute Gap Play this card immediately after someone else plays a Plot card. That card has no effect. Instead, add it to your own hand! You must spend all the Action tokens now on your Illuminati (minimum 1!), and discard the top undrawn card from both your Plot and Groups decks. Requires Discards and All Illuminati Actions

A.M.A. The A.M.A. can act to protect any Science group, or to help attack it, regardless of alignments. It gets a +5 bonus to control, destroy or protect a Science group. Power: 3 Resistance: 4 Peaceful, Conservative | Science
